provenance.evidence: Azerbaijan’s government information page lists the Maiden Tower among monuments of Baku’s Old City and locates it in Icheri Sheher. The page gives disputed phases/dates, so this record does not select a single construction year. Presidential Library describes a cylindrical limestone tower with an eastern projection and eight internal tiers. Original simplified tier bands, slit windows and attached projection; no proposed historic purpose or exact dimensions. All dimensions, colours, simplifications and composition proportions are original art direction, not source measurements. No surveyed-location, current-access, production-quality or legal-rights approval is asserted.
